rec: Runes, or a way of dealing damage which you can smuggle onto Entrana. Runes for Crumble Undead (level 39 Magic) are best
Teleport, preferably to Lumbridge. Home teleport will work if off cooldown
rewards: Ability to buy and wield Dragon Daggers & Longswords

st.t: Talk to the Warrior south east of Draynor Village.
s: What are you camped out here for?
What makes you think it's out here?
If it's hidden how are you planning to find it?
Looks like you don't know either.

st.t: Long-press the tree just to the west and choose Chop. The right tree says Chop, not Chop down.
s: I've been in that shed, I didn't see a city.
I've been in that shed, I didn't see a city.

st.t: Bank all weapons and armour you have (including the axe), and go to Port Sarim to get a boat to Entrana.
i: Runes, or a way of dealing damage which you can smuggle onto Entrana. Runes for Crumble Undead (level 39 Magic) are best

st.t: Climb down the ladder on the north side of the island. Once you go down, you can only escape via teleport.
s: Well that is a risk I will have to take.

st.t: Kill zombies until one drops an axe.

Go south-east past the two level 92 Greater Demons to the Dramen tree. Don't go through the magic door: it takes you into the Wilderness. Attempt to cut a branch from the tree. Be prepared for a Tree Spirit (level 101) to appear, which you can safespot behind nearby fungus.
Kill the Tree Spirit. They can be safespotted behind nearby fungi to the east.
Cut at least one branch from the Dramen tree. It's recommended you cut at least 4 branches so you don't have to return in future quests.
Teleport away with the branches, preferably to Lumbridge.

tr: Teleport, preferably to Lumbridge. Home teleport will work if off cooldown
r: Runes, or a way of dealing damage which you can smuggle onto Entrana. Runes for Crumble Undead (level 39 Magic) are best

st.t: Use a knife on the dramen branch to craft a dramen staff.
Enter the shed south of Lumbridge with your Dramen Staff equipped.
